messages:
laura_pm: Quick sync — need to finalize DP slot trading flow & priority ladder for the upcoming beta. We have ~40 inbound applicants, 15 slots. Can we allow partners to trade slots between cohorts? Need rules + acceptance criteria.

mike_research: Short answer: yes, but limit to pairwise swaps only. Capture reason for swap + updated SLA expectations. Recommend rolling waitlist (top 10) to backfill.

ash_eng: Implementation note: slot trading requires an atomic swap. We can add an endpoint POST /dp/slot-swap {from_id, to_id, cohort} and a DB txn. Need audit log + notif webhooks.

nina_ops: Ops constraints: onboarding windows are Mon/Wed. If swap crosses windows, require explicit opt-in from receiving partner. Prefer same-window swaps only unless both approve. Also cap swaps to 1 per partner per cohort.

laura_pm: High-level success goals: reduce dropouts from ~25% to <10% by allowing safe swaps. Launch metrics: swap acceptance rate, time-to-onboard after swap, 2-week partner NPS. Any other launch gates?

mike_research: Add a quality gate: swapped partners must still pass intake screener. Instrument a 3-day micro-survey: 'was the swap process clear?' Tie that into regression alerts.

ash_eng: Need a rollback plan: if a swap fails mid-transaction, rollback both slot records and notify both parties. I can mock the API + audit events this week — aiming for PR by Wed.

nina_ops: I'll draft partner-facing policy: 'how to request/trade' with examples and an FAQ about cross-window trades. Also will update calendar cadence.

laura_pm: Decision recap: allow same-window swaps + waitlist for cross-window requests. Trading cap = 1 swap/partner/cohort. Requirements: atomic API in prod, audit trail, acceptance survey, intake re-check, ops policy doc, calendar updated, and 3 test swaps executed from staff accounts.

ash_eng: Draft schema I'm going to implement:
```
POST /dp/slot-swap
{
  "from_partner_id": "P123",
  "to_partner_id": "P456",
  "cohort_id": "C2"
}
```
Response example: {"status":"pending","swap_id":"S789"}
I'll wire webhooks for accept/decline and a rollback hook.

mike_research: Metric events to track: swap_requested, swap_accepted, swap_declined, swap_rolledback, swap_time_to_complete. Slice by cohort, region, partner_tier.

nina_ops: I'll run 2 dry-run swaps on Fri 10:00am and invite product + eng to validate end-to-end. Also will add a short clause to welcome emails about swaps.

beta-bot: calendar-poll created: https://cal.example.com/polls/slot-trade-dryrun Fri 10:00am :white_check_mark: 

laura_pm: :thumbsup: Can we reconvene Fri 11:00am post-dry-run to validate acceptance flow and gates? If green, I'll mark as ready-for-dev.

ash_eng: Works for me.

mike_research: Works.

nina_ops: I'll be there and bring the draft policy doc.
